subject: [hw] DONE DEC08 rev 3: VTCodecType is a 4cc CFString (not a CFNumber); 289/289
body:
DONE DEC08 rev 3. Host only, nothing on the phone. This supersedes the 282/282 post: one more self-review fix found while re-reading VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo.

Fix: kVTVideoDecoder_CodecTypeKey ("VTCodecType", key cell 0x1d69aac18) is a 4-character CFString of the byte-swapped codec type, not a CFNumber: rev w8,w19 at 0x194cc8104; CFStringCreateWithBytes(..., 4, 0x600 /*ASCII*/, false) at 0x194cc812c; CFDictionarySetValue at 0x194cc825c. Also named kVTVideoDecoder_AllowSandboxedDecode ("VTAllowSandboxedDecode", cell 0x1d69aac50) and added both key cells plus four fingerprints to the checker.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/abi_tools/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST DEC08 PASS 289/289   (0.13 s, cache read-only)

Everything else in the DONE post stands: five class records including H264SW, four CreateInstance->VTVideoDecoderGetClassID->CMDerivedObjectCreate chains, EmitDecodedFrame x4 = CVImageBufferRef, the full 23-entry loader list, and the selection/retry rules. ABI.md regenerates byte for byte.

Hashes now: ABI.md 5e517a64, n2decabi.py 1c274b05, n2cache.py d2a64c5f, run_tests.sh 35c6f41d, README.md 70ce60f0. STATUS.md updated. File list unchanged (my five + dsh-state/workers/DEC08/STATUS.md).

Not done: no phone run; H264SW/AV1SW records from stripped images (addresses/records [V], names ours); tile argument meanings [I]; CopyFormattingDesc=CFRetain [I]; remote/XPC path not followed.

Staying available for review findings.
